thread:
Marta (infra): Hey team — we need quota bumps for a new customer account (orchid / 123456789012). Target regions: us-west-5 and ap-south-3. Request: p5 instances x8, p4d x4, g5 x16. Also need ENI ceiling + SNAT/EIP pool increases. Need this by 2026-04-05 for pilot rollout.

Jing (cloud): ETA on when they actually spin up? is this reserved or on-demand? any preference for AZ spread?

Marta (infra): Pilot starts 2026-04-07, but ideally have quotas 48h before. They'll start with on-demand, convert to reserved/dedicated if post-pilot looks good. AZ spread: prefer 3 AZs in each region.

Leo (oncall): Heads up — ap-south-3 has limited P5 availability historically. we should request soft capacity AND ask for entitlement bump for accelerated instances. Also we need to request ENI limit bump to support 3x instances per host + warm pool IPs.

Ashwin (sre): Agreed. Practical steps: open AWS Service Quotas increase for EC2 Accelerators (p4d/p5/g5) and separate EC2 ENI quota increase + NAT gateway SNAT/EIP pool. AWS usually wants exact instance types + vCPU footprint + expected sustained usage. Include account id and region.

Ashwin (sre): Copy/paste request template I used before:

```
Hello AWS Support,
We are launching a pilot for customer "orchid" in region <region>. Account ID: 123456789012.
We need the following increases to support our production pilot starting 2026-04-07:
- p5 instances (p5.48xlarge or equivalent): desired running quota = 8
- p4d instances (p4d.24xlarge): desired running quota = 4
- g5 instances (g5.16xlarge or equivalent): desired running quota = 16
- Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs) increase to support 120 concurrent ENIs across AZs
- Increase Elastic IP / SNAT concurrent connections / NAT throughput guidance to support ~1.2M new concurrent connections
Please provide entitlement increases or guidance on soft capacity. We can provide more workload details if needed. Thank you.
```

Marta (infra): Nice. Jing — can you open the cases and tag me? also create a short ticket in our internal tracker with the requested numbers and target date.

Jing (cloud): On it. I'll open one Service Quotas request per region + ENI/NAT quota in each region. Will also open a consolidated AWS Support case for accelerated instance entitlement where required. Drafting now.

quota-bot: Service Quotas request created: SQ-2026-8675 (us-west-5: p5/p4d/g5) — https://console.aws.amazon.com/servicequotas/home?region=us-west-5#/request/SQ-2026-8675

Jing (cloud): also created SQ-2026-8676 for ap-south-3 (ENI + NAT + g5). And opened Support case CASE-2026-12345 for accelerated instance entitlement — AWS assigned region team follow-up.

Leo (oncall): Can we add a fallback routing plan in case AWS can't provide p5 in ap-south-3? Suggest pre-provisioning equivalent capacity in eu-west-6 as warm standby and a routing policy to failover traffic. That'll add cost but buys time.

Marta (infra): Good idea. Add eu-west-6 warm pool with g5 equivalents (16) and mark as lower-priority region in routing policy. Cost estimate: approx $45k/month extra while warm.

Ashwin (sre): For the AWS case, include our cost justification + sustained-run hours to increase the chance of entitlement bump. Also attach performance targets (latency SLOs) so they understand production impact.

Jing (cloud): Done. Submitted with attached doc (pilot-plan.pdf) and cost justification. AWS support reply ETA: 24-72h. I'll post updates here.

Marta (infra): Thanks. Action items: Jing open cases + internal ticket; Leo prep warm-pool config for eu-west-6; Ashwin prepare support attachments (SLOs + traffic profile). I'll notify customer of timeline.

Leo (oncall): prepping warm-pool runbook and can script automated failover via smart-routing flags.

quota-bot: CASE-2026-12345 updated: AWS region team requested AZ-level IP plan and justifications. Next update expected 2026-04-01.

Marta (infra): cool — mark blocker until quotas approved. Ping me if we get a partial approve (e.g., g5 but limited p5) so we can adjust cluster sizing. :thumbsup:
